## History

Small Nell Lucinda is the young daughter of [Isolde Duckett](../character/isolde-duckett.md), identifiable by her black curls. Raised in the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) community, she has been known by her name for two joyful years. She was a topic of gentle conversation between her mother and [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in the attic at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) shortly before Nell's wedding.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P6](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREY SHUTTERS P16](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0016)_
